_comment: Maps fields inside the single AWS Secrets Manager secret to where fetch-secrets.sh writes them on this server. Edit this file (not fetch-secrets.sh) if you add/rename a field in AWS.

env_fields._comment: Single-line values written into deploy/jenkins/.env.secrets as KEY=VALUE.

file_fields._comment: Multi-line values (SSH private keys) written as their own files, one per key, into deploy/jenkins/secrets-runtime/. These files replace the ones that used to live in ~/.ssh.
